title: Advancing Legal Reasoning: The Integration of AI to Navigate Complexities and Biases in Global Jurisprudence with Semi-Automated Arbitration Processes (SAAPs)

bias_targets.methodology: Using custom LLM-based applications (SHIRLEY, SAM) to analyze international court judgments for logical inconsistencies, subtle undertones, and deviations from the literal interpretation of the law (e.g., institutional bias favoring tax authorities). The identified biases are then evaluated through a Semi-Automated Arbitration Process (SAAP) using an AI arbitrator (SARA).

Calibrating the AI model's baseline bias detection by prompting it to rate politically slanted and polarizing news media articles (e.g., InfoWars, Fox News, Financial Times) on a numerical scale prior to analyzing legal judgments.
